title: P1 inventory and evaluation baseline
scope: Read-only inventory and evaluation artifacts. No new parser run, source capture, runtime edit, or research-source mutation.

baseline.firstUnit: candidate records are children, not independent source samples

holdout.assignment: source-post indivisible; deterministic within-channel hash ranks; frozen before new parser work
holdout.familyAware: See family-holdout.json. Its channel/merchant/schedule leave-family-out diagnostic folds exclude whole source groups; overlapping folds are correlated and not pooled. Lexical family tags are split controls, not labels or gold.

expectations.authorship: agent-authored; literal source evidence offsets; not human gold

holdout.freezeReceipt: See freeze-receipt.json; hashes establish the original two frozen files and timing before B/C/D launch.

historicalInventory.scheduleGrammarForms: The prior claim of 27 distinct forms is not reproducible as a stable, source-attributed taxonomy from saved artifacts inspected. Do not claim 27 or substitute the 34 historical normalization units. Current safety fixture contains eight independent date/schedule/source-risk patterns; four are source-group holdout expectations.

denominatorsAndGates.sourceAvailability: 136 original posts; 180 retained candidate children; report source-level denominator separately from child-level diagnostics.
denominatorsAndGates.coverage: For future parser results: parseable required facts / eligible literal opportunities, with abstention and unknown counted separately. Do not score one output per child as independent source accuracy.
denominatorsAndGates.correctness: No accuracy estimate from this inventory. Historical V3/V4 model outputs and agent-authored expectations are not human gold.
denominatorsAndGates.mandatoryGate: Zero unsupported date/clock endpoints, date-role reversals, cross-group schedule/outlet attachment, inferred participation, and false complete-absence decisions on mandatory evidence cases; a missing/ambiguous fact must abstain.
denominatorsAndGates.holdoutGate: Keep family folds disjoint by source group and evaluate each fold separately; publish coverage, safe-fact correctness, abstention, unknown and eligible denominators.

pepper.evidence: Captured official /promo/ listing plus seven linked detail pages (capture observed 2026-09-30T14:58:22.881Z). Listing title/description call it promotions and say “what’s new today”, but structured page metadata has datePublished 2019-04-12 and dateModified 2023-09-12; evidence does not establish that membership is exclusively active offers or that absence proves ended.
pepper.qualification: Official ownership and a list-shaped page alone do not qualify for presence renewal or absence withdrawal. Require explicit active-only semantics and complete traversal evidence; until then classify historical/archive.

shake.evidence: Captured /blog/ listing traversed pages 1–4 with detail articles; this is an editorial blog archive, not a current-only offer index. Captured articles may evidence their own dated facts but cannot renew open-ended validity or establish complete absence.

metrics: No parser outcomes evaluated; no accuracy, precision, recall, or coverage claim.
